name: GAMUDA
recent: Gamuda 近期与霹雳州政府签署北霹雳每日15亿公升供水计划协议，并持续获得合约；同时公布2026财年全年业绩，营收与净利均同比增长。公司也出现董事行使ESOS及多名高管在公开市场售股，EPF 持续申报持股变动。
notable: 与霹雳州政府签署北霹雳每日15亿公升供水计划实施协议。
公布2026财年全年业绩，营收同比增长18.9%，净利同比增长5.3%。
将召开第50届常年股东大会。
risks: 多名董事及高管在公开市场出售股份，包括执行董事及首席运营官。
EPF 在多个交易日持续申报持股变动。
股东大会议程包括授权发行最多10%已发行股份。
earnings: 2026财年全年营收 MYR 5,757,011,000，净利 MYR 349,701,000，净利率 6.1%；营收环比增长29.8%，净利环比增长35.6%；营收同比增长18.9%，净利同比增长5.3%。

recent_en: Gamuda recently signed an agreement with the Perak state government for the Northern Perak water supply scheme of 1,500 million litres per day and continued to secure contracts. It also announced FY2026 full-year results with revenue and net profit rising year-on-year. Meanwhile, directors exercised ESOS and several senior executives sold shares in the open market, while EPF continued to report changes in its shareholding.
notable_en: Signed an implementation agreement with the Perak state government for the Northern Perak water supply scheme of 1,500 million litres per day.
Announced FY2026 full-year results, with revenue up 18.9% year-on-year and net profit up 5.3% year-on-year.
risks_en: Several directors and senior executives sold shares in the open market, including an executive director and a chief operating officer.
EPF continued to report changes in its shareholding over multiple trading days.
The AGM agenda includes authorising the issuance of up to 10% of the total number of issued shares.
earnings_en: FY2026 full-year revenue was MYR 5,757,011,000 and net profit was MYR 349,701,000, with a net margin of 6.1%; revenue rose 29.8% QoQ and net profit rose 35.6% QoQ; revenue grew 18.9% YoY and net profit grew 5.3% YoY.
